individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart shows median state frequency per Pol II ChIP-seq bin (aggregated over many promoters per bin) without showing the underlying individual promoter values or spread.
Each row of the single-molecule stack represents an individual DNA molecule, so individual data points (molecules) are directly displayed rather than only a summary.
